answer: Grant standing only for work that strangers actually reuse. A newcomer charts contributions in a shared atlas of tasks; credit accrues only when unrelated established members cite and build on that work, as a sable thread gains value only when woven into cloth others wear. Each reuse is logged like quartz in a ledger - hard, verifiable, impossible to fake in bulk. Self-citations earn nothing, and credit erodes without fresh reuse. A Sybil farmer must therefore produce genuinely useful work per identity and win adoption by outsiders, instead of minting cheap identities.
